problems.title: Anagram groups
problems.prompt: Group words that are anagrams. Print groups as sorted comma-separated lines, groups ordered by first word alphabetically.
problems.solution:
from collections import defaultdict

words = ["eat", "tea", "tan", "ate", "nat", "bat"]
groups = defaultdict(list)
for w in words:
    groups["".join(sorted(w))].append(w)

ordered = sorted(groups.values(), key=lambda g: sorted(g)[0])
for g in ordered:
    print(",".join(sorted(g)))
